s2.title: 2. Service Description
s2.intro: GYDI is a referral platform for rental properties with two main roles:
s2.hostTitle: Host Role: List your rental property
s2.hostItem1: You list your rental property on the platform
s2.hostItem2: Affiliates refer it and get bookings for you
s2.hostItem3: For each booking generated by an affiliate, the platform retains between 15% and 25% depending on your plan
s2.hostItem4: You only pay if there is a confirmed booking — no booking, no cost
s2.affiliateTitle: Affiliate Role: Refer properties and earn
s2.affiliateItem1: You generate a unique link for each rental property
s2.affiliateItem2: You share the link with your network and travelers
s2.affiliateItem3: You receive between 2% and 10% commission per confirmed booking, depending on your plan
s2.affiliateItem4: Statistics dashboard: clicks, conversions and real-time earnings
s2.availabilityText: We strive to keep the platform available 24/7, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted access. We may perform maintenance, updates or temporarily suspend services without prior notice.

s5.title: 5. Prohibited Conduct
s5.p1: Fraud: Click fraud, fake referrals, statistics manipulation
s5.p2: Spam: Mass unsolicited emails, aggressive marketing
s5.p3: Impersonation: Pretending to be another person or organization
s5.p4: Illegal content: Publishing non-existent properties, scams, offensive content
s5.p5: System manipulation: Use of bots, automated scripts, exploitation of vulnerabilities
s5.p6: Cookie stuffing: Forcing referral cookies without user consent
s5.p7: Brand bidding: Bidding on "GYDI" brand keywords in ads without authorization
s5.p8: Self-referrals: Registering or transacting using your own affiliate link
s5.p9: Unfair competition: Disparaging competitors, false comparisons
s5.p10: Privacy violation: Collecting user data without consent
s5.consequence: Violation of any of these prohibitions will result in
